plan.method: Editable projected planar faces and dense surface grids. World coordinates in cm, scale 1 px/cm; orthographic azimuth 35°, elevation 25°. Verified total height; intermediate widths, heights and decorative dimensions estimated from architectural photographs, not surveyed drawings. Transparent surroundings; only visible +X,+Y and upper surfaces.
references: CTBUH Taipei 101: 508 m architectural height, green double glazing
Oneness & Associates Taipei Financial Center project: eight bamboo modules, corner dragons, circular motifs; public aerial photograph
Facade photographs: silver ruyi ornaments and fine teal curtain-wall grid

whole.requirement: Draw entire Taipei 101 from base to spire, preserving distinctive silhouette.
whole.description: Complete recognizable building, eight flaring tiers, tapering base, upper lantern and full spire, without unrelated scenery.

view.requirement: Fixed elevated three-quarter view with visible top surfaces and consistent perspective.
view.description: Consistent projection on podium, tiers, crown and ornaments.

detail.requirement: Highly detailed realistic architectural illustration, not broad shapes or schematic.
detail.description: Dense native glazing, window frames, projecting bands, visible ornamentation, roof detail and entrance details.

material.description: Teal reflective glass, silver metal, contrasting lit and shaded planes, ledge shadows.

scale.requirement: Real-world dimensions at 1 cm=1 px before perspective.
scale.description: 50800 cm total world height, scale=1; projection shortens visible lengths; local inferred dimensions recorded as estimates.

editable.description: Native individually editable projected faces and facade cells, no raster.

draft.name: 台北101｜公分比例建築插畫

brief.intent: Detailed complete Taipei 101 with native editable glazing and ornaments, isolated on transparency.
brief.viewpoint: Fixed elevated three-quarter orthographic view, azimuth 35 degrees, elevation 25 degrees; cm coordinates at 1 px/cm.
assumptions: 508m total architectural height is sourced. Other local dimensions are proportional estimates from photographs, not certified construction measurements.
Eight tower modules start at z=11800cm and repeat every 3500cm; lantern reaches 44800cm and mast reaches 50800cm.

facts.scope: Architectural top height; does not verify estimated widths or local ornament measurements.
facts.verification: CTBUH building page reports 508 m architectural height.

facts.statement: Taipei 101 uses eight stacked bamboo-like modules with flared upper edges, corner dragon ornamentation and circular motifs near the base-to-tower transition.
facts.scope: Architectural arrangement and design motifs; local shape and dimension estimates are not as-built certification.
facts.verification: Architect project description and aerial project image establish the adopted composition and motif families.

calculations.verification: 508 metres × 100 centimetres/metre = 50800; draft projection scale is 1 pixel per world centimetre. Projection elevation 25 degrees shortens vertical projected lengths.
